title: Define project layout model and item identity
body:
Build the GUI-free arrangement model, validation, deterministic reconciliation, and persistent per-Content layout identity. Preserve identities across tab moves and cold restore without changing Member or Control-plane ids.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md
Blocked by: None
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Mixed Content, tabs, tiling, floating/minimized restore state, normalized geometry, and stable matching follow the spec.
- Missing/same-kind substitutes/extras reconcile deterministically; every current item survives exactly once.
- Validation rejects malformed, oversized, duplicate, unknown, or non-finite arrangements. Tests witness failures before implementation.
- Keep visibility narrow and preserve existing workspace compatibility; no picker or provider implementation in this card.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
